title: Space bound from a head-position radius
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over Boolean symbols, let $x$ be a Boolean input word, and let $B$ be a natural number. Suppose that at every time and on every work tape, the head position in the run of $M$ from its initial configuration on $x$ lies between $-B$ and $B$. Then, for every $t\\in\\mathbb N$, the total space used through step $t$ is at most $k(2B+1)$, where $k$ is the number of work tapes of $M$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Turing machine over Boolean symbols
